description: Create a static proxy pool from proxy lines (host:port, host:port:user:pass or user:pass@host:port). Prefix a line with socks5:// for a SOCKS5 proxy; http:// or no prefix means HTTP; https:// is rejected (TLS to the proxy is not supported). Bad lines are reported in `rejected` by line number (counting from 1) and do not block good ones; if no line is valid, nothing is created. Returns pool_id for create_profiles or assign_proxy_pool. Passwords are stored but never returned.
name: import_proxies
